roadmap.name: Senior AI Engineer
roadmap.description: Comprehensive roadmap covering software engineering foundations, architecture, backend, data, distributed systems, cloud, DevOps, testing, observability, ML/LLM systems, security, governance, product, documentation, leadership, and professional judgment.

nodes.title: TWO. Design Patterns and Application Architecture
Most importantly: knowing when not to use a pattern
EIGHT. DevOps and Software Delivery
nodes.notes: This isn't just DevOps trivia. DORA currently treats continuous integration, deployment automation, testing, version control, database change management, observability, maintainability, and related capabilities as core parts of effective software delivery.

nodes.title: NINETEEN. Responsible AI and Governance
nodes.notes: NIST's GenAI profile is particularly useful here because it treats these concerns across the AI lifecycle rather than as an isolated compliance exercise.

nodes.title: TWENTY-TWO. Code Review and Engineering Quality
nodes.notes: This is not just my interpretation. Google's published review guidance explicitly emphasizes design, functionality, complexity, tests, naming, comments, documentation, and overall code health.
